about.intro_content: Prof. Yun-Fei Yuan is a Professor in the Department of Liver Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. His clinical practice and research focus on hepatic and biliary malignancies, including hepatocellular carcinoma and colorectal liver metastases.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Yuan is skilled in orthotopic liver transplantation, hepatectomy (including hemi-hepatectomy, trisegmentectomy and two-step hepatectomy), pancreatoduodenectomy, and transcatheter hepatic artery chemoembolisation. He is a key member of SYSUCC's multidisciplinary team for colorectal liver metastases and pioneered the use of the indocyanine green retention rate at 15 minutes (ICGR15) in China to evaluate hepatic functional reserve before liver surgery, helping reduce postoperative liver failure. He completed research fellowships at Baylor College of Medicine and MD Anderson Cancer Center in the United States as a World Health Organization Fellow.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Yun-Fei Yuan

items.question: Does Prof. Yun-Fei Yuan accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to liver or biliary cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Yuan's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Yuan specialises in hepatic and biliary malignancies, including hepatocellular carcinoma, biliary cancer, and colorectal cancer liver metastases, with expertise in complex hepatectomy and liver transplantation.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Yuan treat liver cancer with portal hypertension?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Yuan has researched and published on the optimal surgical and interventional treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with portal hypertension, a clinically complex scenario.

items.question: What makes Prof. Yuan's approach to liver surgery distinctive?
items.answer: Prof. Yuan pioneered the use of the indocyanine green retention rate (ICGR15) test in China to assess liver function before surgery, helping reduce the risk of postoperative liver failure in complex hepatectomy cases.
